The Gombaszög Summer Camp is one of the biggest summer events for young Hungarians in Slovakia: a week-long festival, a free university and a camp. The event is currently being held since 2008, but not without any precedent!

The beginnings of this tradition date back to 1928, and from the 1960s onwards (often in spite of the socialist systems of the existing barrier) the Hungarian university student clubs in Czechoslovakia gained new impetus and spirituality. Today, the event has thousands of campers and visitors!
